reason: I've never heard of Mëva and there are no reviews yet, and I read every review before I buy from a brand I don't know. Paying now for a jar I can't check is not something I'll do with my budget, even at the early price.
objection: I don't know if I'd like the taste or texture, and nobody has told me yet. Gummies with sugar and glucose syrup can be sticky or too sweet, and I can't try one before paying.
would_change_my_mind: Honest reviews from women my age on Trustpilot or Amazon who say the taste and texture are good and that they noticed a difference, or a way to try one jar before paying the full price.
